info.title: ambientCG API v2
info.description: ambientCG's v2 API as Volter Editor calls it: /full_json, and the download door its downloadLink values name. Written from https://docs.ambientcg.com/api/v2/full_json/ and the host's answers (spec/SOURCE.md).

get.summary: This endpoint is the most comprehensive endpoint. It delivers metadata and downloadable files for all assets in a JSON-format.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search Query. A list of keywords, separated by commas or spaces.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The data type of the assets: 3DModel, Atlas, Brush, Decal, HDRI, Material, PlainTexture, Substance, Terrain. Multiple values can be concatenated using a comma which will be interpreted as a logical OR.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Method used to create the asset.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Defines the order of the results: Latest, Popular, Alphabet, Downloads. Not setting the parameter, setting it to an empty string or any other value will be interpreted as Latest

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Can be used to select specific assets by their id. Multiple values can be concatenated using a comma. Non-existent ids will be ignored.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Returns all assets released on one specific day.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Defines the maximum number of results to be shown.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Defines the offset in the results. The offset will only take effect if a limit (see above) has been set.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Controls what data should be returned.

downloadFolders.description: downloadFolders.default.downloadFiletypeCategories.zip.downloads: each with fullDownloadPath, downloadLink, fileName, size, filetype, attribute, zipContent

previewImage.description: a thumbnail url per size and format (64-PNG … 2048-PNG, …-JPG-FFFFFF, …-WEBP)

get.summary: A download: a redirect to the file on the download host.

404.description: This download could not be found.
